❗️ Two people have been killed in Kryvyi Rih following Russian strikes, local authorities report. Russian forces first struck a restaurant in the city center, where families with children, staff, and an ambulance crew were present. As emergency responders and police began evacuating people, a second strike, this time by a drone, hit the area. A female paramedic was killed, along with a 7-year-old boy who later died in hospital. Another 42 people were injured, including four children. Twenty-seven victims are in serious condition. Two emergency responders and two police officers are among the wounded. The strikes damaged 23 apartment buildings, a hospital, commercial properties, vehicles, and State Emergency Service equipment.

The Roman principle of “divide and rule” has often been applied to Russia throughout its history and even still is, President Vladimir Putin said. “There is a well‑known Roman expression — ‘divide and rule.’ This often happened throughout our country’s history. As soon as it grew stronger and more powerful, forces immediately emerged that wanted to divide and rule,” he said. “I believe that what is happening now is a continuation of the same policy — divide and rule — and the desire to reduce Russia’s potential, to make it more compliant, and ultimately, one way or another, in one form or another, to subordinate it to their own interests. Everyone should understand and know this, including those who live in Russia. We know this, we understand it; I feel it and see it in the state of our society.”
